timing_note: PAR2 uses post-setup method wall time and 2x timeout for incomplete methods. Adaptive-versus-prefix and crossover comparisons use SAT instances only: on UNSAT the root call ends traversal before any variable choice. Algorithm ratios exclude process startup and include scoring, construction, solving, verification. End-to-end estimate adds worker setup to each method. Five-millisecond tolerance avoids classifying timer noise as wins. With two held-out seeds, Wilson intervals remain wide. Spearman screens are descriptive and confounded by size/family; duplicated deterministic formulas are deduplicated in that screen.
unsat_note: Generator-known contradictions and dedicated XOR/2-SAT algorithms provide independent checks for selected families; public UNSAT has no independently checked proof certificate.
